facades.name: church_south
facades.source: Street View Jul 2025 (official pano 5YCmGqNQ_wpwB2T9Wbyi8w), four frames rectified with tool/sv_rectify.py: Saborna crkva Preobraženja Gospodnjeg, south side
facades.look: the south side of the Serbian Orthodox Cathedral of the Transfiguration: pale warm-grey rusticated ashlar stone in regular courses; vertical pilaster strips capped with small pediments and square carved rosettes; tall round-arched windows with dark leaded glass, each in a stone surround under a blind relieving arch, one narrow arched window with lattice glazing at each end; in the middle a shallow gabled porch with a small pediment holding a golden mosaic, two columns with carved capitals and a dark wooden arched door; a heavy dentilled cornice with a carved frieze along the top. The photo is an elevation with grey patches = unknown (continue the same stone there). A black wrought-iron railing and a long stone bench stand along the foot: draw the stone plinth instead. Leave out the people, the tree and the crane. No text.

facades.name: church_north
facades.source: INVENTED: the north side mirrors the south side (no street view of it)
facades.look: the north side of the Serbian Orthodox Cathedral of the Transfiguration, a mirror image of the south side in the photo: pale warm-grey rusticated ashlar stone, pilaster strips with small pediments and rosettes, tall round-arched windows with dark leaded glass under blind arches, a shallow gabled porch with a dark arched door in the middle, dentilled cornice. The photo is an elevation with grey patches = unknown (continue the same stone). Leave out the railing, people and the tree. No text.

facades.name: church_west
facades.source: Street View Jun 2018 (user photosphere Garaža Cvjetni), frame h90 t100: the west front
facades.look: the west front of the Serbian Orthodox Cathedral of the Transfiguration, straight on: pale warm-grey rusticated ashlar stone with a heavy stone plinth; in the middle a deep round-arched portal with carved colonnettes and a dark wooden double door up three stone steps, two wrought-iron lanterns on brackets beside it; above it a tall arched double window with lattice leaded glass and a rosette; on both sides a tall narrow niche with a mosaic icon of a saint; pilaster strips at the corners and beside the window with small pediments; a dentilled cornice at the top. Leave out the people, bicycles and railings. No text.

facades.look: INVENTED, ignore any wording about copying a photo: the semicircular east apse of the Serbian Orthodox Cathedral of the Transfiguration drawn unrolled as a flat rectangular elevation: pale warm-grey rusticated ashlar stone in regular courses, three tall round-arched windows with dark leaded glass in stone surrounds under blind arches, vertical pilaster strips between them, a stone plinth, a dentilled cornice along the top. No text.
